content.comment_body: [article_no] /[product_name] [version_no] + [product_name] Starterkit I have this kit and I want to purchase one of the energy analyzers listed on this [url] site. Is it possible to read data from these analyzers using this kit? I am new to PLC programming, thank you for your understanding.
Apologies, I am unable to read or speak Turkish. If you need assistance, please upload the data sheet for your energy analyzer in English.
Hello, I will buy this analyzer [url] and the technical datasheet is available here: [url]. Thanks for your help.

[url] I mentioned already that I can't read or write Turkish. The [product_name] supports only Modbus TCP/IP, not Modbus RTU. If you wish to use this Modbus device, you will need a gateway that converts Modbus RTU to Modbus TCP/IP.

analysis.insight_summary: The user inquired about connecting an energy analyzer to a [company_name] PLC and operator panel kit for energy monitoring. The primary user experience insight is that users seek straightforward integration between [company_name] PLCs and third-party energy analyzers but face challenges with compatibility, particularly around Modbus RTU versus Modbus TCP/IP protocols. Documentation accessibility and language barriers further complicate onboarding for beginners.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects simple and direct communication and data reading between the [company_name] PLC and the external energy analyzer, without needing additional hardware or protocol converters. The user is looking for clear, beginner-friendly instructions for integration.
